name: cursor-rtl
description: Smart multi-language RTL support for Cursor AI Chat. Uses a purpose-built algorithm that auto-detects text direction per element - Hebrew, Arabic and Persian text is right-aligned while English stays left-aligned.

commands.title: Cursor RTL: Enable RTL / Fix After Update
Cursor RTL: Code Editor Direction (Auto / Always / Off)

enumDescriptions: Code editor direction follows each file's dominant language: Hebrew/Arabic/Persian files flow RTL, English and code stay LTR
Force every code editor to right-to-left
Never change the code editor's direction
cursorRtl.editorRtl.description: Right-to-left direction for the code editor — the main editing pane, including Markdown and plain-text files (Monaco). Applies live to open windows; no reload needed. To set a different direction for some files, use Editor Rtl By File below.

defaultSnippets.label: Keep one file type LTR
defaultSnippets.description: Never change the direction of .prisma files

cursorRtl.editorRtlByFile.markdownDescription:
Code editor direction for files whose name matches a pattern, overriding `#cursorRtl.editorRtl#`.

**Item:** a file name pattern. `*` matches any characters, `?` matches one. Only the file name is matched, not its folder, and case is ignored. Examples: `*.md`, `*.prisma`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `Dockerfile`.

**Value:** `auto`, `always` or `off`.

When several patterns match a file, the most specific wins: `CHANGELOG.md` beats `*.md`. Example: set Editor Rtl to `off` and add `*.md` → `always` to keep code LTR and Markdown RTL. The **Cursor RTL: Code Editor Direction** command adds a rule for the open file's type.

cursorRtl.editorRtlByLanguage.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `#cursorRtl.editorRtlByFile#`, which matches file names (`*.md`) instead of language IDs. Entries here are moved there automatically.

cursorRtl.markdownPreview.description: Right-to-left support in the built-in Markdown preview: every paragraph, heading, list and table cell follows its dominant language. Open previews refresh when this changes.

cursorRtl.autoReloadAfterPatch.description: After the patch is re-applied (e.g. following a Cursor update), reload the window automatically. When off, a Reload Window prompt is shown instead.

cursorRtl.showStatusBar.description: Show RTL status indicator in the status bar

cursorRtl.checkForExtensionUpdates.description: VSIX installs only: check for Cursor RTL updates in the background and install them automatically, preferring the marketplace over the GitHub release (a small toast shows progress; you only confirm the window reload). Marketplace installs are updated by Cursor itself and ignore this setting.

cursorRtl.updateCheckIntervalHours.description: How often the background update check runs while Cursor is open (VSIX installs only)
